calculation.expression: 0.5 - (close - rolling_min(close,60)) / (rolling_max(close,60) - rolling_min(close,60) + epsilon), shifted by one completed session
calculation.description: Cross-asset reversal score that is positive for instruments near the lower end of their trailing 60-session price range and negative for instruments near the upper end. Uses only data available through the prior completed session.

validation.regime_notes: Positive full-sample predictive association across the 15-asset benchmark. H10 remains positive in recent 365 and 120-session windows; uncertainty is interpreted conservatively because the cross-section is small, although 1672 dates and approximately 15 instruments per date were used.
